product.title: Private Custom Tour: Kyoto in One Day

description.text: In Kyoto, this private custom day builds a half-day or full-day route from a published UNESCO stop list rather than a fixed coach loop. The listed options include Kinkaku-ji, Nijo Castle, Fushimi Inari-taisha Shrine, Tenryu-ji Temple, and Kiyomizu-dera, with hotel pickup inside Kyoto city. A professional English-speaking guide travels by public transport or a private vehicle depending on the selected option, and lunch is listed on the full-day window. Pickup outside Kyoto city is not offered. The format suits first-time visitors who want a tailored temple day without assembling shrine and castle timing independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Kyoto, and the itinerary stays on Kinkaku-ji, Nijo Castle, Fushimi Inari, and Kiyomizu-dera that shape this outing rather than a Nara park add-on.
